preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 2*10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices N for each test case is between 1 and 200,000.
The total number of vertices across all test cases is at most 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(C) == N for C, N in zip(Cs, Ns))
preconditions.description: Length of color string C is equal to the number of vertices N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'RGB' for c in C) for C in Cs)
preconditions.description: Color string C consists only of 'R', 'G', and 'B'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for edges, N in zip(Edges, Ns) for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) has valid vertex indices and u is not equal to v.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for edges, N in zip(Edges, Ns))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly N-1 edges forming a tree.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['Yes', 'No'] for i in range(T))

all(output[i] == 'Yes' if all(any(c == 'R' for c in path(u, v, graph, Cs[i])) and any(c == 'G' for c in path(u, v, graph, Cs[i])) for u, v in blue_pairs(graph, Cs[i])) else 'No' for i, (graph, Cs[i]) in enumerate(zip(Graphs, Cs)))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is 'Yes' if for all pairs of Blue vertices (u, v), there is at least one Red vertex and one Green vertex on the simple path between u and v; otherwise 'No'.
